# libpng and zlib use modular unsigned arithmetic intentionally.
[unsigned-integer-overflow]
src:*/pngrutil.c
src:*/sources/zlib/*.c

# zlib intentionally narrows internal values to its fixed-width table types.
[implicit-integer-conversion]
src:*/sources/zlib/*.c

# libtiff's LZW bit accumulator intentionally discards emitted high bits.
[unsigned-shift-base]
src:*/sources/libtiff/libtiff/tif_lzw.c
